name: [FPS] Flick
desc:
Fast paced, free-for-all arena where every person has a sniper.  Grab your rifle and hunt your enemies

🎯Snipe enemies
🔫Unlock new snipers
🔪Unlock new Knifes
🔥No teams, no mercy just pure skill



This Game Is In Beta 
Give your Feedback in the group forums 

Controls:

[PC] 💻
Mouse 1: Fire
Mouse 2: Aim
Q: Swap Weapons
F: Inspects 
M: Menu

[Controller] 🎮
R1: Fire
L1: Aim
Y: Swap Weapons
B: Inspects 
X: Menu

[Mobile] 📱
Follow the on-screen button diagrams for all actions.
